title: Settings, cardio & workout polish
highlights: Settings is reorganized into a hub with Training plan, Device & timers, and App & updates on their own pages.
Warm-up and cool-down sections collapse automatically when every stretch is checked off.
Workout rows are easier to log—the actions menu sits on the left, with clearer checkboxes and timer/rep controls.
Many Hybrid Calisthenics leg and lunge exercises now have their own coaching notes instead of generic squat text.
Cardio progress charts show average speed (mph) when you log distance and time; tap a session for pace and speed.
Activities logged with distance and time also save average speed to Health Connect on Android (install the latest app build).

title: Health Connect & timer audio
highlights: Finished workouts and logged activities can be saved to Health Connect as exercise sessions.
To enable this, open Health Connect → App permissions → MyExercise and allow Exercises write access.
Timer sounds on Android briefly lower music volume when a set or rest timer finishes.
